$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the multi-target build. Edit this, then run `npm run build` to regenerate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, plugins/*, and manifest.json. CI (`npm test`) fails if the generated files drift. A plugin composes with other plugins two ways: `dependencies` is a build-time CLOSURE — the build bundles every dependency's skills+hooks+agents into the self-contained plugins/<name>/ dir that BOTH harnesses install (no native, Claude-only resolution, so Claude Code and Codex install identically). `requires` is a documented-only dependency — NOT bundled and NOT auto-installed; the user installs it themselves. Use `requires` when a plugin builds on another but shouldn't ship a copy of it.

marketplace.name: lightcone-research
marketplace.description: Agent skills for the Lightcone Research stack — the ASTRA spec and lightcone-cli project workflows.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and composition mechanics. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Core workflow for a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: `new` scopes a new analysis from a research question, `cli` carries the lc execution reference (spec–code invariant, status interpretation, failure diagnosis), and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Bundles the astra reference, so this one plugin is all you need for interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project.

plugins.name: lightcone-experimental
plugins.description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Paper reproduction (`from-paper`), code import (`from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), autonomous iteration (`ralph`), and manuscript verification (`check-sentence-by-sentence`, `figure-comparison`). Requires the `lightcone` plugin (install it first) — these skills build on the core lc workflow, hooks, and lc-extractor subagent but do NOT bundle them. Install when you need capabilities beyond the core analysis workflow.
